title: GBTSVR: Twin Support Vector Regression via Granular Ball Computing
abstract: arXiv:2610.20053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regression models used in real-world applications are often challenged by noise, outliers, data heterogeneity, and asymmetric error characteristics, which severely limit the effectiveness of conventional point-wise learning models. While twin support vector regression (TSVR) partially addresses these issues through the use of nonparallel regression bounds, it still relies on individual samples as basic learning units. As a result, TSVR remains highly sensitive to noisy and contaminated observations and fails to leverage the underlying structural and regional information inherent in complex datasets, leading to suboptimal robustness and generalization performance. To address these limitations, we introduce granular ball twin support vector regression (GBTSVR) and its quantile extension, granular ball twin support vector quantile regression (GB-TSVQR). translated_title: GBTSVR：基于粒球计算的孪生支持向量回归
translated_abstract: 现实世界应用中的回归模型常常受到噪声、异常值、数据异质性以及非对称误差特性的挑战，这些因素严重限制了传统逐点学习模型的有效性。虽然孪生支持向量回归（TSVR）通过使用非平行回归边界部分地解决了这些问题，但它仍然以单个样本作为基本学习单元。因此，TSVR 对含噪和受污染的观测数据仍然高度敏感，并且无法利用复杂数据集中固有的结构和区域信息，导致鲁棒性和泛化性能欠佳。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了粒球孪生支持向量回归（GBTSVR）及其分位数扩展——粒球孪生支持向量分位数回归（GB-TSVQR）。所提出的模型将粒球计算与 TSVR 相结合，用粒球取代单个数据样本作为基本学习单元。
tldr: 提出 GBTSVR 及其分位数扩展 GB-TSVQR，以粒球取代单个样本作为基本学习单元，显著提升了孪生支持向量回归在噪声、异常值和数据异质性场景下的鲁棒性与泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GBTSVR and its quantile extension GB-TSVQR, which use granular balls instead of individual samples as basic learning units in twin support vector regression, achieving improved robustness and generalization against noise, outliers, and data heterogeneity.
